query: How can a solo, newly-forming SDVOSB founder (staff engineer, agentic-AI skills, no clearance, VetCert + SAM pending) realistically earn substantial, sustainable revenue selling RAG/agentic-AI software and services to the US federal government (VA first, others second) as of Oct 2026?
audience: The founder; informs a go-to-market plan built on the rag-system repo
materiality_assumptions: In scope: unclassified federal civilian (VA priority), unclassified DoD/DHA, veteran-ecosystem adjacent markets (VSOs, state VA depts, accredited agents)
Out of scope: classified work, state/local outside veterans affairs, international
Figures must be current to 2025-2026; anything changed by the 2025 FAR overhaul or 2025 EOs flagged

angles.A1: SDVOSB mechanics: VetCert, Vets First/rule of two, FAR 19 thresholds, RFO changes, MPT/SAT, VA goals, mentor-protege, LoS
angles.A2: Demand: VA AI strategy/inventory, VBA/VHA AI initiatives, OMB M-25-21/22, 2025 EOs + GSA consolidation, OneGov AI deals, DoD/DHA demand
angles.A3: Vehicles and entry paths: T4NG2, GSA MAS/AI SIN, SEWP VI, Polaris, CIO-SP4, SBIR status, OTA/CSO/DIU/Tradewinds, VA innovation, subcontracting
angles.A4: Compliance: FedRAMP 20x, inherited GovCloud, VA ATO, 508, FIPS, CMMC, LLM availability in FedRAMP High/GovCloud, air-gapped
angles.A5: Competition, pricing, labor rates, small-firm VA AI wins, new-entrant failure modes
angles.A6: Adjacent veteran-ecosystem markets: VSOs, accredited agents, state DVAs/state SDVOSB prefs, 38 CFR 14.629 + GUARD Act limits
